flagged.title: Photosynthesis, Limiting Factors and the Inverse Square Law
flagged.reason: The video states that the waxy cuticle functions to reflect excess light, which is scientifically incorrect and would lose marks on GCSE questions regarding leaf adaptations (where the cuticle is transparent to allow light through and waterproof to prevent water loss).

mark_affecting.quote: It's even got a waxy cuticle to reflect excess light
